written: 2026-10-20, before any held-out trial and before the prompt was frozen
goal_template: Open System Settings and navigate to {dest}.
completion_check: Independent: after the model says DONE, a fresh macos-use refresh of System Settings shows the first visible [AXWindow (standard window)] title equal to the destination (NFKC, NBSP/non-breaking-hyphen and case normalised). Fully completed = model said DONE while the check is true, within 10 proposals, no human intervention.

starts.closed: System Settings quit (osascript quit) before the trial; the model must OPEN it
starts.pane_top: System Settings open on a given pane, sidebar scrolled to the top (setup clicks done by the harness, not the model)
starts.pane_bottom: System Settings open on a given pane, sidebar scrolled to the bottom (setup by the harness)

conditions.A: compact current state + list of the last 3 actions (no outcomes)
conditions.B: same state + last action with a goal-independent diff of what changed (title, sidebar items)

stop_rules: same action proposed twice in a row after it produced no screen change
an AXSheet dialog or a different frontmost app after an action
destination reached but model proposes another action (not executed; counted as missed completion)
metrics: correct next actions (vs a reference judgement written after the run, see report)
completion recognition (DONE when reached; no DONE when not)
tokens and latency per step, total time
